finding: Slovak firms shifted toward refinancing as fixed investment financing fell
bullets: Refinancing or paying off obligations was cited by 21.1% of Slovak firms (n=192), rising 4.1 pp from 17.0% in the previous wave and exceeding the EA rate of 15.9%.
Fixed investment financing fell from 40.7% to 34.1% among Slovak firms (n=191), placing Slovakia 5.3 pp below the EA's 39.4% — a reversal from the prior wave when SK exceeded the EA.
Inventory and working capital remained the dominant financing purpose for Slovak firms at 55.8% (n=193), 15.1 pp above the EA's 40.7%, easing 1.2 pp from 57.0% in the previous wave.
